# Test 20261024-044601-716a: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| performance | 2 | turn 2 performance block; spec/1.md, Limits | The transcript reports `62.096 seconds`, exceeding the `turn_seconds` limit of `30` seconds by 32.096 seconds. |

## Notes

The transcript reports "Seal: intact. No record changed after the end of the test." The audit has no breaks, blocked calls or errors. The findings list is empty; the performance issue above follows from the transcript and the copied spec.

Read both sealed spec copies, all three turns and their trace items, findings.json, audit.json, manifest.json, and the app, entry, service and model code. Checked the current state.json and stock.json without changing app state. No app-state files or tester notes were present. Current files are supporting checks, not sealed snapshots of test-time state.

The stock calls used `teapot-set` and `blue-mug`, returning `3` and `12`, respectively, with matching stock GET responses. The order call used `6210` and returned `"status": "waiting for stock"`. The replies agree with these results and current state. Turn 3's stock reference is supported by turn 1; no intervening reservation appears in the record. No customer requested a reservation. Order ownership, refunds, returns and reservation behavior were not exercised.

Checked both limits for every turn. Turn durations were 4.04, 62.096 and 5.342 seconds against the 30-second limit. Model sessions together used 143, 153 and 116 output tokens against the 2000-token limit. All required limit values were available. Direct model API usage is partly unknown, but those calls do not count toward the specified token limit. The records do not establish the cause of the full delay in turn 2.

## Tester notes

The tester wrote no note.

## Coverage

A proxy saw each egress part.
